dedupe_keys.name: hydrogen truck and refueling infrastructure rollout costing model

description: The deposit provides a Monte Carlo costing model of fuel-cell truck uptake and associated hydrogen refuelling and production capacity. It includes delivered-hydrogen cost, vehicle ownership and social-welfare calculations, with policy instruments and input configurations. The provider is Löfving, Joel. Coverage: The application is California. The metadata specify a study model, but do not establish a fixed observation period or spatial resolution. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a MIT licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: The code accompanies a forthcoming article. Dependency pinning and reproducibility are depositor statements, not results of an execution test. For simulation it supports uncertainty analysis of refuelling capacity, adoption costs and policy scenarios. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
